CatalogRequestUpdate3.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    updateReqItemData: function() {
        var ritmID = this.getParameter("req_item_id");
        var question1 = this.getParameter("question1");
        var question2 = this.getParameter("question2");
        var question3 = this.getParameter("question3");

        var ritm = new GlideRecord("sc_req_item");
        ritm.get(ritmID);

        ritm.variables.question1 = question1;
        ritm.variables.question2 = question2;
        ritm.variables.question3 = question3;
        
        ritm.approval = 'requested'; 
        ritm.state = -102; 
        
        ritm.update();
        return "true";
    },
    type: 'CatalogRequestUpdate3'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-06-06 07:21:29</sys_created_on><sys_id>1bae815483826610cfe0a470ceaad323</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>CatalogRequestUpdate3</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Scripting" source="x_1755520_scriptin">203f384e83792690cfe0a470ceaad3b6</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Scripting">203f384e83792690cfe0a470ceaad3b6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_1bae815483826610cfe0a470ceaad323</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-06-06 07:21:29</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
